planets.name: TOI-782 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-782 with a 8.02-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-782 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-782. Its orbit and size follow Hori et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
